title_zh: 确定学生奖项推荐的具体事例

scenario.label_zh: 用具体证据确定学生奖项推荐重点
scenario.goal_zh: 区分团队成果与个人贡献，并决定以记录方法和帮助同学的事例支持推荐

context_zh: 美国学校的两名教师讨论一封尚未撰写的学生奖项推荐信。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Ms Brooks
sentences.text: The science fair results are encouraging. Should we nominate Lila for the student award?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: I think so, but the project was a collective endeavor. We should not give her credit for everyone's work.

sentences.speaker: Ms Brooks
sentences.text: What evidence of individual excellence can we point to?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: Her lab notes were exceptional. Other teams could repeat the experiment from her records without asking for missing steps.

sentences.speaker: Ms Brooks
sentences.text: She also helped two younger students set up their own records. I saw that during the practice session.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen
sentences.text: Then those are the examples we should use, rather than just saying she won a prize.

sentences.speaker: Ms Brooks
sentences.text: Agreed. I will draft the nomination around her clear records and the help I observed, and name the project as team work.

targets.sense_zh: 努力；共同事业（美式拼写）
